description: This PHP source file defines the LikeOperator class, which implements string filter operators using the 'LIKE' SQL operator in the context of the SuiteCRM JSON API filters. It provides methods for converting to filter tags and SQL syntax, and validates operator strings.

classes.name: LikeOperator
classes.description: Implements a string filter operator that uses the 'LIKE' SQL keyword for pattern matching, used within the SuiteCRM JSON API filtering framework.

methods.name: toFilterOperator
methods.description: Returns the filter operator tag for 'like'.

methods.name: toSqlOperator
methods.description: Returns the string 'LIKE' representing the SQL operator.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates that the provided operator is a string and calls the parent validation method.
